# Tripadvisor Reviews Scraper

The Apify actor [`maxcopell/tripadvisor-reviews`](https://apify.com/maxcopell/tripadvisor-reviews) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.234**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Get and download reviews for chosen places on Tripadvisor. Extract the review text, URL, rating, date of travel, published date, basic reviewer info, owner's response, helpful votes, images, review language, place details. Download reviews in XML, JSON, CSV.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Actor Start $0.00005, Review $0.005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/maxcopell/tripadvisor-reviews) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/maxcopell-tripadvisor-reviews@0.0.234#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array |  |  | Start URLs — Paste here a URL(s) of a specific place you want to get reviews from. |
| `sourceDatasetId` | string |  |  | Tripadvisor Scraper dataset ID of a finished run — Dataset ID of a finished Tripadvisor Scraper run to get start URLs from. |
| `maxItemsPerQuery` | integer |  |  | Limit reviews for each place — Use a large value (for example 1 million) to get all reviews from each place. If you want to set a limit across all reviews use 'Options' -> 'Maximum charged results'. |
| `scrapeReviewerInfo` | boolean |  | `true` | Scrape reviewer info — Scrape reviewer info (name, profile picture, location etc.). ⚠️ This returns personal data. You're responsible for having a legal basis to collect and use it under privacy laws. |
| `lastReviewDate` | string |  |  | Only reviews since date — It is a date where the scraper stops loading older reviews. Select the date in format YYYY-MM-DD or {number} {unit} *(e.g. '3 days' or '1 week')* |
| `disableMachineTranslations` | boolean |  | `false` | Disable machine translation of the reviews — When enabled, the reviews are returned in their original language instead of the Tripadvisor machine translation to English. Note: the original texts are loaded with one additional request per page of reviews. |
| `reviewRatings` | string[] |  | `["ALL_REVIEW_RATINGS"]` | Review ratings — Select and filter only the desired review ratings. For all ratings, select the 'All ratings' option. Useful if you want to scrape only reviews with certain ratings. |
| `reviewsLanguages` | string[] |  | `["ALL_REVIEW_LANGUAGES"]` | Reviews languages — Select the desired reviews language. Note: English reviews are prioritized, so your reviews come in English first and then in other languages. ⚠️ Tripadvisor changed its review logic - it now works with only one selected language. ## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `placeInfo` | any | Summary information about the reviewed location. |
| `id` | string \| null | Unique numeric review ID. |
| `lang` | string \| null | BCP 47 language code of the review text. |
| `originalLanguage` | string \| null | Original language of the review text. |
| `isMachineTranslated` | boolean \| null | Indicates if the review is machine translated on the TripAdvisor website. |
| `locationId` | string \| null | Tripadvisor location ID the review belongs to. |
| `publishedDate` | string \| null | Date when the review was published (`YYYY-MM-DD` format). |
| `publishedPlatform` | string \| null | Platform the review was originally published on, if known. |
| `rating` | number \| null | Star rating given by the reviewer (1–5). |
| `helpfulVotes` | number \| null | Number of helpful votes received. |
| `url` | string \| null | Direct URL to the review on Tripadvisor. |
| `travelDate` | string \| null | Month and year of the visit (`YYYY-MM` format). |
| `text` | string \| null | Full review text. |
| `user` | any | Reviewer profile information. |
| `title` | string \| null | Review title / headline. |
| `ownerResponse` | any | Owner's response to the review, if any. |
| `subratings` | array \| null | Category-level sub-ratings (e.g. food, service, value). |
| `photos` | array \| null | Photos attached to the review. |
| `tripType` | string \| null | Type of trip (e.g. `BUSINESS`, `COUPLES`, `FAMILY`, `FRIENDS`, `SOLO`). |
